en.content:
In Seedance 2.0, upload an image with a face as the First Frame to generate a video. Use the First Frame to lock only the initial pose, allowing the character to move naturally afterward.  
First, generate a high-quality character First Frame image using GPT-Image 2, then input this image as the First Frame in Seedance 2.0 to create a video from the image.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I vibe directed a full rock music video. No editing software. Not a single cut made by hand.👋

I just talked. Scene by scene, I described the vibe — the grit, the neon, the energy — and it directed the whole 60-second film: same artist from first frame to last, locked face, real lip sync, stage lights, sparks, camera moves swinging on the beat. All from a conversation.

No prompt tricks. Just a director's eye and the words to describe what I saw in my head.

This is vibe directing — and it's the most creative fun I've had in years. 🎸🔥

Here's exactly how I made it, step by step 👇

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] GPT- image 2 prompt 👇

An exquisitely beautiful cinematic Tang Dynasty lady portrait, featuring a slender East Asian woman with a soft and delicate oval face, her skin smooth and porcelain-like with a lustrous glow. A delicate gold foil plum blossom adorns her forehead, her eyebrows are long and slender like willow leaves, subtly shaded in light indigo. Her eyes are expressive almond-shaped, slightly upturned at the corners, clear as autumn water, not looking at the camera but slightly turned to gaze at the distant left side of the frame, with a serene and distant expression as if recalling the latter half of a poem. Her cheeks have a subtle blush, her lips are finely shaped and painted with vermilion lip color into full cherry lips, the corners naturally slightly upturned, not a smile, but a naturally gentle curve. Her hair is styled in a high cloud bun, black hair piled like ink clouds, adorned with a gilded peony hairpin and a pair of jade drop earrings, with a half-bloomed red peony pinned at the temple, a few strands of hair naturally falling beside her fair neck. She wears a grand Tang Dynasty chest-high ruqun, the inner layer is a light apricot gauze short blouse fitting her body, outlining her slender shoulders and arms, the outer layer is a rouge red brocade chest-high long skirt, the skirt waist is cinched high under the chest with a gilded brocade belt, the skirt layers spread to the ground like a pile of red clouds, with a smoke-blue sheer large-sleeved robe draped over, the fabric light and transparent, naturally flowing, faintly revealing the warm colors of red and apricot underneath. She stands quietly, hands naturally clasped in front of her skirt, her posture slightly turned to the left side of the frame at a three-quarter angle, her back relaxed, neck long, her demeanor relaxed and elegant, like a moment caught when she was alone in the garden admiring flowers. The background is a corner of the imperial courtyard in late spring, behind her is a large blooming peony tree, the flowers large and layered — Luoyang red and Yao yellow interwoven into a floral wall, the petals thick and lush, a few petals just detached, gently falling on her shoulder and hair. Behind the peony tree, a vermilion corridor and grey eaves are faintly visible, further away are the softened outlines of palace structures in the mist. The light is the last moment of the golden hour in the evening, warm sunset light pouring from the back right of the frame, outlining a honey-gold translucent rim light on the edges of her robe and hair, her face softly lit by diffused light filtered through the flower tree, small floral shadows falling on her forehead and left shoulder, the gilded hairpin catching the sunset light reflecting a few star-like glints. Overall, it's like a scene from Zhang Xuan's "Lady Guoguo's Spring Outing" infused with cinematic depth and light-shadow breathing, 85mm f/1.2 portrait lens, extremely shallow depth of field melting the foreground peony and background palace wall into a soft creamy bokeh, Kodak Portra 160 film stock's delicate skin tone reproduction and gentle highlight transition, the color scheme elegant and bright — rouge red, apricot, gilded, smoke blue, peony pink, all colors wrapped in a layer of honey light, not glaring but very rich, the atmosphere is the most gentle dusk of the Tang Dynasty's golden age, everything just right, beautifully understated.

En Seedance 2.0, sube una imagen con un rostro como el First Frame para generar un video, usando el First Frame solo para fijar la postura inicial, permitiendo que la persona se mueva naturalmente después.  
Primero, usa GPT-Image 2 para generar una imagen de alta calidad del First Frame de la persona, luego ingresa esa imagen como el First Frame en Seedance 2.0 para crear un video a partir de la imagen.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
Dirigí un video musical de rock completo con solo vibras. Sin software de edición. Ni un solo corte hecho a mano.👋

Solo hablé. Escena por escena, describí la vibra: la rudeza, el neón, la energía, y dirigió toda la película de 60 segundos: mismo artista del primer al último cuadro, rostro fijo, sincronización real de labios, luces de escenario, chispas, movimientos de cámara al ritmo. Todo a partir de una conversación.

Sin trucos de prompt. Solo el ojo de un director y las palabras para describir lo que veía en mi mente.

Esto es dirigir por vibras, y es la diversión creativa más grande que he tenido en años. 🎸🔥

Aquí está exactamente cómo lo hice, paso a paso 👇

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] GPT- image 2 prompt 👇

一张极致唯美的电影感唐代仕女人像，主体是一位身姿窈窕的东亚女性，鹅蛋脸庞线条柔和而精致，肌肤细腻白皙透着瓷器般的润泽光感，额间贴一枚精致的金箔梅花花钿，眉型是细长的柳叶远山眉以淡黛色层层晕染，一双含情丹凤眼眼尾微扬，眸光清亮如秋水，没有看向镜头，而是微微偏首望向画面左侧远处，神情恬淡悠远像是想起了一首诗的后半句。面靥两点若有若无，唇形精巧以朱砂口脂点出饱满的樱桃唇，唇角自然微抬，不是笑，是一种天生的柔美弧度。发髻为高耸的云鬓飞仙髻，乌发堆叠蓬松如墨云涌起，髻上斜插一支鎏金牡丹花簪与一对翡翠滴珠耳坠，鬓边簪一朵半开的鲜红牡丹，几缕碎发从鬓角自然垂落在白皙的脖颈侧面。身着一袭盛唐齐胸襦裙，内层是杏色轻罗短衫贴合身体勾勒出纤细的肩线与手臂轮廓，外是胭脂红织金大团花齐胸长裙，裙腰高束于胸下以一条鎏金锦带打结收束，裙摆层层铺展至地面如红霞堆积，最外披一件烟青色薄纱大袖衫，衣料轻盈透明自然垂坠，能隐约透出内层红与杏的暖色。她只是静静地站着，双手自然交握于身前裙摆之上，身姿微微侧向画面左侧呈四分之三角度，脊背舒展颈部修长，体态松弛而优雅，像是独自在庭中赏花时被谁无意间看见的那一瞬。背景是暮春时节的皇家庭院一角，身后是一株巨大的盛开牡丹树，花朵硕大层叠——洛阳红与姚黄交织成一面花墙，花瓣质感肥厚温润，几片花瓣刚刚离枝缓缓飘落在她肩头与发间。牡丹树后隐约可见一道朱红色回廊与青灰色飞檐翘角，更远处是被薄雾柔化的层叠宫阙轮廓。光线是傍晚 golden hour 的最后一刻，暖色夕光从画面右后方倾泻，在她纱衫边缘与发丝上勾出一层蜜金色的透光轮廓 rim light，面部是被花树过滤后柔和的漫射光，细碎的花影光斑落在她的额头与左肩，鎏金发簪捕捉夕光折射出一两点星芒。整体如同一幅张萱的《虢国夫人游春图》被注入了电影的景深与光影呼吸，85mm f/1.2 portrait lens，极浅 shallow depth of field 将前景一枝低垂的牡丹与背景宫墙都融化为柔美的奶油散景 creamy bokeh，Kodak Portra 160 film stock 的细腻肤色还原与柔和高光过渡，色彩体系温雅而明丽——胭脂红、杏色、鎏金、烟青、牡丹粉，所有颜色都像被一层蜜光包裹过，不刺目却极丰盈，氛围是大唐盛世最温柔的那个黄昏，一切恰到好处，美得不动声色。
